summary: Frontend-only regression of dynamic community headers and multi-activity days completed on the public URL. Core persistence, creation/reopen/removal/delete flows, empty filtering, legacy migration, merged preview rows, 30,764-byte PDF download, reload persistence, and mobile stacking passed. Three non-blocking UI/count defects were reproduced.

ui_bugs.issue: A single card is labeled 'Atividade 1' instead of the required 'Atividade 1 de 1'. Reproduced on a new day, after removing entry 2, and with a legacy single-object day.
Summary counts active days, but labels the value as activities. With 5 activities across 3 days, both screens show '3 atividades cadastradas'.

issues: The remove-entry X is functional and visible but its touch target measures only 24x24px; increase it to at least 44x44px for reliable touch use.

action_items: Always render the EntryCard ordinal as 'Atividade N de total', including total=1.
Compute displayed activity totals by summing normalized day-array lengths, or relabel the existing Object.keys count as days.
Increase remove-entry button padding/minimum dimensions to a 44x44px mobile touch target.
critical_code_review_comments: ActivityForm.jsx conditionally appends `de ${total}` only when total > 1, directly causing the single-card acceptance failure.
Home.jsx activeCount and Schedule.jsx count use Object.keys(monthData).length, which represents active days rather than activity entries after the data-model refactor.
The remove-entry button uses p-1 around a 16px icon, producing a 24px square hit area on mobile.

success_rate.frontend: 90% functional acceptance; all core data/PDF flows passed with 3 non-blocking UI/count issues

seed_data_creation: Browser-local localStorage only: updated community to 'Comunidade Renovada JSC'; created two activities on 2026-08-15; tested a filtered single activity on day 16; seeded three activities on day 15 plus single and legacy-object days for preview/PDF tests. No backend data changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest the single-entry label in new, post-removal, and legacy states; verify Home/Schedule show 5 activities for 1+3+1 entries across three days; remeasure remove-entry at 390x844. Confirmed PDF artifact downloaded successfully at 30,764 bytes. Production build compiled successfully.
rca_of_the_issue: The ordinal defect is a render condition (`total > 1`) in EntryCard. The inaccurate totals are residual pre-refactor day counts (`Object.keys(monthData).length`) now presented as activity counts. The mobile target is constrained by `p-1` plus a 16px X icon.
